name: updateCategoriesAdvanced
description: Renames or changes the icons of several categories at once.

categoryId.description: The category's id, as shown in category search results.

newTitle.description: The category's new title; one another category already has is refused. Leave it out to keep the current title; it can't be removed.

newIconImage.description: The category's new icon picture. Leave it out to keep the current icon; it can't be removed.

categories.description: The changes to make, up to 50 per call, one category per entry, each exactly as a single update would be.

callback.description: Runs when it's done, with each category's outcome.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as when any entry is invalid, does not resolve or repeats a category, in which case nothing is changed.

categories.description: One outcome per input entry, in input order.

index.description: The entry's position in the input list, from 0.

id.description: The category's id, if it worked.

error.description: Why the entry failed, if it didn't.
